_README.title: US Growth vs Value Indices - Daily Snapshot
_README.description: Russell growth and value indices across large-cap and small-cap segments
_README.purpose: Track growth vs value performance to identify market style rotation

style_definitions.growth: Companies with higher price-to-book ratios, expected faster earnings growth
style_definitions.value: Companies with lower price-to-book ratios, trading at discounts to intrinsic value

indices_included.^RUA: Russell 3000 - Total US equity market (98% coverage)

interpretation.growth_outperforming: RLG > RLV and RUO > RUJ = Growth stocks leading
interpretation.value_outperforming: RLV > RLG and RUJ > RUO = Value stocks leading
interpretation.large_cap_leading: RLG > RUO and RLV > RUJ = Large-caps preferred
interpretation.small_cap_leading: RUO > RLG and RUJ > RLV = Small-caps preferred
interpretation.rotation_signal: Style leadership changes indicate market regime shift

pivot_points.description: Support and resistance levels calculated from previous day's price action
pivot_points.formula: Pivot Point = (High + Low + Close) / 3 from previous trading day
pivot_points.levels: 3 resistance (R1, R2, R3) and 3 support (S1, S2, S3) levels for each index
